description.value: Shady Island Seafood Bar & Grill is a full-service waterfront seafood restaurant and bar situated in the historic Steveston Village, where the Fraser River meets the ocean. In addition to the main dining floor, it offers a second-floor licensed pub called Vicky's Lounge with views over Shady Island — stairs access only and 19+. Steveston is a well-known destination on Richmond's cycling routes, making this a natural refuelling stop for touring cyclists in the area.
